findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "extract" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Agis Web Scraper — Fetch any public web page and return its main content as clean markdown (title, description, headings, links, lists). Optional JavaScript rendering (render:true) for SPAs / JS-heavy pages. Ideal for RAG and agents that need to read a URL." → after: "Fetch any public web page and return its main content as clean, token-efficient Markdown (title, description, headings, links, lists). Set render:true to execute JavaScript first for single-page apps or JS-heavy pages that would otherwise come back empty. Built for RAG and for agents that need to re"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
